name: io.github.WYRE-AI/acronis-mcp
title: Acronis Cyber Protect Cloud
description: Hosted WYRE-AI wrapper around the Acronis MCP server (@acronis-platform/mcp 1.0.1): alerts, policies, resources, agents, tenants, EDR incidents.

environmentVariables.name: ACRONIS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Acronis datacenter URL, https only, hostname must end with .acronis.com (e.g. https://us5-cloud.acronis.com)

environmentVariables.name: ACRONIS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to expose the 3 write tools (default: read-only)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
